title: Panel Mounting Accessories Price in Pakistan 2026 — DIN Rail, Mounting Plate, Cable Duct & Panel Lock Complete Buyer Guide
summary_html: Panel mounting accessories price Pakistan 2026: DIN rail (TS35 7.5mm, 15mm deep, TS32, G-rail), steel mounting plates (1.5mm–3mm CRS), slotted cable duct (25×25mm to 100×100mm), panel door locks (cam, three-point, pad-lockable hasp), hinges, gland plates. PKR prices, IEC 60715 and IEC 61439-1 specifications, 8 Pakistan-specific selection rules for 50°C ambient, coastal corrosion, WAPDA compliance, and dust-environment requirements. Complete selection matrix for domestic, commercial, MCC, outdoor, coastal, agricultural, hospital, and WAPDA metering panels.
